name: Lock In
text: When switching into this mon, it forces the opposing mon to only use actions that share it's typings.

name: Voodoo
text: Every hit dealt on this Animate is dealt to a random opponent at 50% of its power.

name: Fear
text: The second half of all attacking actions an opponent uses loses 20% accuracy.

name: Hidden
text: Speed is reduced, but speed and ranged defense is increased.

name: Hover
text: Immune to all Earth actions. Ranged Defense is dropped.

name: Deadeye
text: All ranged attacking actions gain 10% accuracy, up to 90%.

name: Single Point of Failure
text: Non-super effective actions have no effect on users. This does not apply to Lucids.

name: Change Gear
text: Once dropped under 50% HP, this animate will enter its Feral form.

name: Smoke Bomb
text: Anytime this animate attacks, it switches out unless not possible.

name: Bullet Proof Vest
text: Artillery damage is reduced by 80%. Speed is dropped.

name: Stressful
text: Anytime this animate does any actions consecutively, the opponent gains a chance to flinch.

name: Costume
text: This animate appears to the opponent as another animate in the party, with the exact stats and passive, but not action set.

name: Synergy
text: For each turn this animate shares the field with an Electric, Metal, Water, or Air ally, it gains a temporary bonus to Melee Attack, Ranged Attack, and Speed. The bonus resets when either animate leaves the field.

name: Flamboyance
text: Opposing attacking actions with less than 100% Accuracy lose 5% Accuracy against this animate (8% for Savage attacks). Has no effect against another animate with Flamboyance.

name: Pitiful
text: The opponent that knocks this one out leaves the field.

name: Blall
text: If an ally Blarb is on the field, both Defense stats multiply by 10x until either this Animate or that Blarb leaves the field.

name: Perfectly Elastic
text: Any damage this animate takes from status effects is also dealt to the opponent.

name: Recycle
text: Items used on this animate are restored to your inventory after the battle.

name: Cat Burglar
text: Melee attacks have a 10% chance to steal the target's held item. Consumable items are used immediately.

name: Interest
text: For every 2 EP not used in a turn, the next turn gets +1 EP.

name: Underdog
text: Missed attacks increase Critical Hit chance until a Critical Hit lands.

name: Polyhex
text: Mystic attacks have a chance to repeat, however all Mystic attacks have a max of 60% accuracy.

name: Adaption
text: The first typing to hit this Animate in a turn becomes not very effective for the rest of the turn.

name: Bread And Butter
text: All non-food attacks do 0.5x from this Animate, and all food attacks do 1.25x.

name: Super Guard
text: The first super effective hit on this Animate is neutral each turn.

name: Defensive Strategy
text: Every turn, if this animate gets hit once, gets a defense up.

name: Clean Slate
text: Loses all status effects upon switching in.

name: Rage
text: Every action this Animate hits, it gains +1 EP the next turn.

name: Leadership
text: All allies gain +5% to all stats except HP.

name: Powerful Authority
text: All allies gain +10% to all stats except HP.
